About.title: A new name. The same night-time voice.
About.p1: Kyx-Nyx is an independent female rap artist based in Switzerland. She writes and performs in English, moving between sharp rap verses and sung, melodic hooks.
About.p2: Her sound is dark, emotional and cinematic: night music built on heavy beats, atmosphere and vulnerability. Previously known as Thug-W-Angel (TwA), she now steps forward as Kyx-Nyx.
About.p3: On stage she brings that intensity to festivals, clubs, showcases, cultural events and private occasions — in every Swiss language region.

Booking.h1: Book Kyx-Nyx for your event in Switzerland
Booking.intro: Kyx-Nyx is a female rap artist based in Switzerland, performing in English. Tell us about your event — festival, club, showcase, cultural, private or corporate — and you will receive a reply with availability and conditions.
Booking.why1Text: Melodic, dark and cinematic rap that stands out in a line-up.
Booking.why2Text: Understood across all Swiss language regions and by international audiences.
Booking.why3Text: Independent artist — your request goes straight to the artist's team.
Booking.why4Text: Set length and set-up adapted to your event and venue.
Booking.regionsText: Everywhere in Switzerland — Romandie, German-speaking Switzerland and Ticino. Events abroad on request.
Booking.step1: Send your request with the form below.

faq.a1: Anywhere in Switzerland — Lausanne, Geneva, Fribourg, Neuchâtel, Valais, Bern, Zurich, Basel, Lugano and beyond. International dates on request.
faq.q2: In which language does she perform?

faq.a3: Festivals, clubs, showcases, opening slots, cultural events, private parties and corporate events.
faq.q4: What should I include in my request?

Epk.intro: Everything programmers, journalists and partners need: bio, facts, photos and contact.
Epk.short: Kyx-Nyx is an independent female rap artist based in Switzerland. Writing and performing in English, she blends rap and singing into a dark, emotional and cinematic sound. Formerly known as Thug-W-Angel.
Epk.long1: Kyx-Nyx is an independent female rap artist based in Switzerland. She writes and performs in English, moving between sharp rap verses and sung, melodic hooks.
Epk.long2: Her music is dark, emotional and cinematic — night-time rap built on heavy beats, atmosphere and vulnerability. After releasing music as Thug-W-Angel (TwA), she now continues under the name Kyx-Nyx.
Epk.long3: Kyx-Nyx performs live at festivals, clubs, showcases, cultural and private events across Switzerland.
